1.title: Questions arrive at your pace.
1.description: Life doesn't pause for you to study. Questions arrive throughout the day, on your time, with no set schedule. You answer when you can, and when you get one wrong, you understand why right away, not just that you missed it.

chat.text: Complete: "We need to ___ the proposal by Friday." (finalize)
finish
Almost! The right word here is "finalize": "We need to finalize the proposal by Friday."
💡 "Finalize" is the right verb to formally wrap something up. "Finish" works, but sounds informal here.

2.title: Want to practice right now? Just ask.
2.description: Sometimes you just want to practice more. In those moments, one command changes the pace: questions start arriving back to back, without waiting for the day, at whatever speed you want to go.

chat.text: practice

Intensive practice mode activated. Questions arrive one after another, at your pace. 

_Stop using *pause* or after 15 minutes without a reply._
Complete: "She ___ to the gym every morning." (goes)
goes
✅ Nice! "She goes to the gym every morning."
What does "deadline" mean?
final due date
✅ Exactly! "The deadline is next Friday."
You showed up (late) to an important meeting and apologized as you walked in. What's the term in English?
late
✅ Nice! "You showed up late to an important meeting and apologized as you walked in."

Pick the right option: "I ___ finished the report."
a) have
b) has
c) having
a
✅ Correct! "I have finished the report."

3.title: Listen and repeat. Train listening too.
3.description: Reading and writing isn't the same as understanding and speaking. Feedback can arrive as audio, you hear the correct pronunciation and repeat it, training your ear and your speech in the same place where you already practice everything else.

chat.text: Complete: "I need to ___ a meeting for tomorrow." (schedule)
schedule
Nice! "I need to schedule a meeting for tomorrow."

4.title: Also works with material you already have.
4.description: Already have material from class? You don't have to choose one or the other. Send a photo, PDF or text whenever you want, and questions come straight from that content.

5.title: A summary every time you switch activity.
5.description: Switching topics shouldn't erase what you've already built. Every time you change activity or send new material, a quick summary arrives with what's behind you, before the next question comes in.
